comments.author: Andrew Gwinner
comments.text: Investigation done. Demo Dashboard renders vendor topBar.js which predates logo support (title 'Aurora' text only); vendor shell.css has no logo rules. UI logo = renderTopBar logo param + .top-bar-with-logo/.top-bar-logo CSS + icons/aurora-logo.png. Divergence is surgical: topBar.js differs ONLY by the logo feature; shell.css 41 diff lines; DashboardScreen 14 (no-stop seam). Favicon tab part already done (Aurora-k1q). Recommended: surgical vendor update (logo-capable topBar.js, logo CSS rules, aurora-logo.png into vendor icons/, logo param on vendor DashboardScreen call) -- demo-layout override cannot inject the img element. Awaiting go-ahead to touch the fork.

title: Theme-aware favicons for WebUI and demo
description: A swaps 282828 to DDDDDD under prefers-color-scheme: dark via embedded SVG style; media-matched PNG pairs (favicon-light/dark.png) cover tab chrome without SVG favicon support. Verified visually by reporter (OS theme toggle). Committed.

title: Replicate Web-Demo edge padding back to WebUI
description: Port the demo shim's edge-padding treatment (web/demo/demo-layout.css root rules) back into web/ui/styles/shell.css so both surfaces share edge behavior. Scoped 2026-09-20: demo uses literal 12px top / 16px sides / 24px bottom gutters plus a documented landscape missing-right-padding fix and overflow-x-hidden rationale; ui uses token gutters (space-6 sides, space-8 bottom) on a 640px centered column with scrollbar-gutter:stable already in place. Neither surface handles safe-area-insets today (out of scope unless added deliberately). Work: diff the two root rule sets line by line, port what ui lacks, verify visually on-device (no browser in sandbox). Demo vendor fork (Aurora-4jl) stays intentional.
close_reason: Closed

comments.author: Andrew Gwinner
comments.text: Root cause found at 292px: the accordion pills AND the top bar (Stop button borrows its width rules) both overhang the content column 21px/side (dashboard.css), but the page gutter is only 16px and below 650px viewport there is no centering margin left to absorb the extra 5px. Demo never shows it because its pane padding nests outside the ported container gutter. Fix: @media (max-width:649px) scales both overhangs to 12px/side (>=4px breathing), pill inner padding tracks. Contract test: web/ui/styles/dashboard.test.mjs; CI loop extended.

comments.author: Andrew Gwinner
comments.text: Follow-up: narrow overhang 12px -> 6px/side so side breathing (16-6=10px) matches the top bar's 10px top padding. Test now asserts the match cross-file (gutter vs top-bar token). Also fixed the test's comment-stripping so '@media' in prose can't phantom-block the parser.
